risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (411.2) with flat yield curve and imminent NFP event create severe macro headwinds; earnings in 35 days adds moderate binary risk.

debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI, Stochastic, Williams %R), VIX crisis regime (411.2), earnings binary risk in 35 days, price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA, and zero fundamental/smart money conviction create compounding downside risks that outweigh technical strength.

decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis environment combined with RSI/Stochastic extremes and earnings binary in 35 days creates compounding tail risk; price near resistance with weak macro backdrop.
